shared_elements: predatory quadruped rendered with large eye and open muzzle
vertically stacked composition of motifs on an upright block
justification: Both surfaces depict animals combined with a field of net-like/hatched geometric patterning on an upright, vertically stacked carved block, and both include a snarling predator-like beast with prominent eye and muzzle. However, A is a flat, schematic low-relief scene of registers containing a bird in profile, small quadrupeds, arched hut-like signs and a zigzag band, while B is an almost fully three-dimensional, comparatively naturalistic animal head crowned by a scaled body — different depicted subjects, no shared figure-to-figure relationships, and no matching order of motifs.
